name: rain_metal

source.title: Medium rain on a tin roof
source.author: Sassaby
source.notes: 48 kHz 16-bit stereo, 123 s of medium rain on a tin roof, mixed to mono: a dense, ringing wash with few drops standing out (under 1 a second 4 dB over the rest) and no events (sound-ambience.py). Chosen by the author over kyles' light tin roof (451152), cocaine's metal shed roof (611424) and mdsn's drops on a metal roof (322579) (see SOUND_REWORK.md). Stretches from its steady middle (35-120 s, within 3 dB), each level within 0.7 dB between halves (scratchpad pick_swells.py); its first 35 s build up and its last second ends.

shape: 2 s swells (0.6 s in, 0.5 s out), as the calm and medium rain's, played with them where a rain sound lands on metal (RainSurface.METAL), in place of most of it (the filtered rain keeps 0.3). Cut at the calm rain's average level (RMS about -46 dB); how loud it plays against the rain is set in code.
